description: Follows Fritz Haber’s physical chemistry and the laboratory synthesis of ammonia, distinguishing chemical equilibrium from reaction kinetics and the experimental work with Robert Le Rossignol from the industrial scale-up led by Carl Bosch and collaborators. Connects synthetic nitrogen to agriculture, environmental costs, German research institutions and Clara Immerwahr’s constrained scientific career before World War I.
